newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed, demand steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed, demand steady.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were mixed Thursday as dealers pointed to an improvement in feed business, especially in Texas, Oklahoma and Missouri.
"It's that time of the season," a St Louis dealer said."I would venture to guess that people are getting set to do range cube business for fall usage."
Range cubes are pellets for cattle, he said.
Feedmills are expected to be busy in the next few weeks in Texas, Oklahoma and Missouri. "Two weeks ago, the Texas feed business was terrible, so that is a big change," he said.
Spot north Texas was traded at $117.00 a ton compared to 10 days ago when it traded at around $95.00, he added.
But in other locations business was either flat or just hand-to-mouth. "We feel (corn) prices may go higher later on so now it's a good time to own some stuff," another dealer said.
One Minneapolis broker said the only action now was weekend business.
In the Northeast, there was a little bit of trading but not a great deal, a Buffalo dealer said. He noted that most of the feed was in the hands in feedmixers.
